title: Restoring a Work Tape Cell
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes over Boolean symbols, let $a$ be a one-step action, and let $i$ be a work-tape index. After applying $a$ to $c$, overwrite tape $i$ at the original head position with the symbol (or blank) that was under that head in $c$. The resulting tape function is exactly the tape $i$ function in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A Boolean input word $x$ and a configuration $c$ on input $x
replaced:
For any configuration $c$, action $a$, and work-tape index $i$: writing the symbol
that was under head $i$ in $c$, at $c$'s head position, into tape $i$ after $a$
has been applied restores tape $i$ exactly to its contents in $c$. This covers
no-write actions and writes of the blank symbol.
